summary: Frontend-only UI polish regression at 390x844 via Expo web preview. These all WORK: welcome -> Log in -> Fix-it list with the 3 count tiles and 6 items. On scroll, the header-title 'Fix-it list' fades in (opacity 0 -> 1), the wordmark and page-title fade out, and the bottom border appears. All 4 tabs render with no console errors. The bench chip row (bench-tabs) stays sticky at top=66 while scrolling. + Add contractor sheet: fill, then Save closes the sheet and shows an 'Added' toast. Issue screen: Find help -> Request -> AI draft (277 chars) -> Copy text logs a Waiting request with a toast -> Booked -> day/time chips -> Save booking moves the issue to Scheduled ('Booked for Tue, Oct 27, 2:00 PM') and the How did it go form appears. screen-back-button returns to the Fix-it list. Snap: Describe it -> Find help returns AI results in about 5s -> Track this opens /issue/{new id}. Rentals: Reset demo confirm sheet and Load demo both work (property IDs regenerate). Amenity tile -> /bench?focus=id, which highlights the slot. Logout -> /welcome with no blank screen. Scroll reveal: at every scroll position checked on Fix-it, Rentals, Bench and Welcome, no card that was inside the viewport was below 0.9 opacity. At the bottom of the list every card is at 1.0. No 'Maximum update depth' or 'Unexpected text node' errors; the console was clean in every run. No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch are absent). Issues found: (1) the Snap 'Describe it' card renders narrow (x 59-331 instead of 20-370) because the Card reveal wrapper drops alignSelf:'stretch'; (2) /issue/[id] has no auth guard, so a deep link while logged out shows 'We couldn't find that issue / Not authenticated' instead of redirecting; (3) a toast with Undo stays up after logout and covers the welcome CTA for up to 8s; (4) minor design items.

ui_bugs.issue: The outer Animated.View only forwards `flex` from style. alignSelf, width and margins stay on the inner view. On Snap 'Describe it' (app/(tabs)/snap.tsx:77, which uses alignSelf:'stretch' inside an alignItems:'center' parent), the card shrinks to its content width: 272px wide and centred instead of full width. Fix: forward alignSelf, width, margin* and position style keys to the outer wrapper, or default the wrapper to alignSelf:'stretch'.

Opening /issue/{id} with no session (deep link or reload after the token expires) shows an EmptyState 'We couldn't find that issue' with the body 'Not authenticated' (the API returns 401). It should redirect to /welcome like the (tabs) layout does (app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:19).

A toast with an action (for example 'Booked. Status: Scheduled. Undo', duration 8000ms) stays on screen after logout. It overlaps the welcome page 'I already have an account' button, and tapping Undo would call the API with no token. Clear the toast when logout runs.

issues: The bottom toast (8s when it has an Undo) covers the 'Save outcome' button of the How did it go form right after booking. There is no tab bar here, so the toast sits on top of content. Consider raising it or adding bottom padding while a toast is showing.

The Tahoe Cabin property badge says 'All covered' while its Hot tub tile shows '1 contractor'. The Bench page says 'Only 1 backup' and the Fix-it list shows the gap 'Only 1 hot tub contractor at Tahoe Cabin'. The coverage messages contradict each other.
Amenity tile labels truncate on 390 width ('Kitchen ap...', 'Appliance rep...'). The '#1 Sierra Spa Service · 94' line wraps with a dangling '· 94'.
The page title is 'Properties' but the tab label is 'Rentals'.
Chip height is 36px (src/ui.tsx:154), below the 44px minimum touch target. Used for bench tabs, booking day/time and add-contractor trade/area chips.
Welcome: after scrolling, the top bar with 'Log in' scrolls away (it is not sticky). Fine, but the only login entry is then at the very top.

action_items: src/ui.tsx Card: pass layout keys (alignSelf, width, margin*, position) from style to the outer reveal Animated.View (or set alignSelf:'stretch' on it) so the Snap Describe-it card is full width again.
Add an auth guard to app/issue/[id].tsx (if user === false, return <Redirect href='/welcome' />), or put a guard on a shared stack layout.
Clear the active toast in logout() (or when user becomes false) so Undo toasts don't carry over to the welcome screen.

Optional: make the Rentals property 'All covered' badge agree with the single-backup gap logic; raise Chip height to 44 or add hitSlop; offset toasts on stack screens so they don't cover primary actions.
Optional: Screen.tsx RefreshControl onRefresh should use try/finally so `refreshing` can't stay true if onRefresh throws.
critical_code_review_comments: src/ui.tsx:123 Card reveal uses onLayout y, which is relative to the direct parent, not the ScrollView content. A Card nested in a container (welcome steps, bench slots, cards in sheets) gets an underestimated y, so it reveals early or skips the animation. It can never get stuck invisible, so this is safe, but the effect is inconsistent. useWindowDimensions height ignores the header and tab bar, so the reveal point sits about 150px lower than the visible edge.
src/ui.tsx:119 Content below the fold goes back to 0.2 opacity when you scroll up. That is expected and off-screen, but cards just above the tab bar sit at partial opacity until you scroll.
src/components/Screen.tsx:85 refreshing state has no try/finally.
Screen.tsx passes ScrollYContext to Sheet children through the React tree (Modal portal), so Cards inside sheets react to the page scroll. Harmless now.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 8 requested flows pass; 1 layout regression on Snap Describe-it card)

rca_of_issue: Snap Describe-it narrow card: Card in src/ui.tsx now wraps the visual card in an outer reveal Animated.View that only gets `flex`. The parent snap-capture View has alignItems:'center', so the outer wrapper shrinks to its intrinsic width and the inner alignSelf:'stretch' only stretches inside that narrow wrapper. Measured: input at x 79-310, card about 59-331, against 20-370 for the other buttons.
